svg.title: Sections of the power cones
svg.desc: Sections at u = 1 of power cones: the curves t = |v|^(1/a) for a = 0.3, 0.5 and 0.7 and the rotated cone t = v^2/2 for a = 1/2; each cone is the region above its curve. The point (v, t) = (2, 10.079) on the a = 0.3 curve is the optimum of minimize t with u = 1, v = 2. Analytic figure; membership tested with expcone_barrier and the optimum checked against PRIMAL at revision 1f2ddee.
svg.text: Sections u = 1 of the power cones
Shaded: the cone a = 0.3. Each cone is the region above its curve; all curves are even in v.
The optimum of min t with u = 1, v = 2 is t = 2^(1/0.3) = 10.0794, on the boundary.
